items.title: GROUP CHATS!!!
items.description: IT'S HERE! Multi-user group chats have been finally added! Click the plus icon beside the new "Your Conversations" menu and start adding away!

items.title: Release Notes System
items.description: Say hello to the brand new NEXUS What's New system, allowing you to stay informed about new features, improvements, and fixes!

items.title: NEXUS App
items.description: We're actively working on the new NEXUS desktop application for macOS and Windows!

items.title: Browser Authentication
items.description: We've added browser-based authentication within the app, so you don't have to type in your username/email and password every time.

items.title: Password Changing
items.description: We've added the ability to change your account password through Settings, so your account stays secure.

items.title: Desktop Landing Page
items.description: We gave the NEXUS desktop application a full makeover with a brand new landing page and easier login/signup!

items.title: Web Domain
items.description: We've have a new domain!! https://talknexus.github.io will now redirect to https://nexus.qwertydev.me, which is our new home!

items.title: Settings Navigation
items.description: We've fixed an issue where the Back to NEXUS button in Settings scrolled too far down the page when you opened the profile settings.

items.title: Fixed Spaces Rail unread count
items.description: We've fixed the unread notification counter from only showing one notification/DM

items.title: and much more...
items.description: We've polished and fixed other minor bugs to make NEXUS better for you!
